newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-FORMER FRANCE COACH BERBIZIER MOVES TO NARBONNE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FORMER FRANCE COACH BERBIZIER MOVES TO NARBONNE.

text.p: Pierre Berbizier, coach of the French side which finished third in 1995 World Cup, will take over at first division team Narbonne next season.
Berbizier said on Sunday he had signed a two-year contract with the club.
The former international fly-half was replaced by Jean-Claude Skrela as national coach for this year's Five Nations tournament which was won by France.
